title: Incident bot: snapshot overload breaker state + post triage checklist for #incidents
author: Caleb Johnson
description: Context: As part of Hosted circuit breakers + load shedding, oncall needs quick, consistent context during overload events (breaker open/half-open by (model, region, tier), shed/admission rates, queue depth) and a standard checklist to avoid ad-hoc triage. Today we manually hop between dashboards + routing admin endpoints and the first 10 minutes are noisy, especially during retry storms. This PR enhances incident-bot so that when an incident is created (or when a responder runs /incident overload-snapshot), the bot (1) snapshots current breaker states and key overload signals into the incident thread, and (2) posts a standard overload triage checklist with links to the overload dashboard panels and suggested mitigations. Behavior: - Posts into #incidents in the incident thread (not the channel root) to reduce noise; - Uses a 30s cache for snapshots to avoid thundering herd when multiple incident updates happen; - Best-effort: if routing/capacity endpoints are degraded, bot posts partial data + notes what failed; - Redacts any customer identifiers; all output is aggregate by region/model/tier. Snapshot contents (v1): - Breaker state counts by (region, tier) and top affected models; - Recent breaker transitions (last 10m) if available; - Shed rate (gateway + runtime) and admission rate (last 5m) from metrics API; - Queue depth + GPU saturation summary per region; - Recommended Retry-After guidance currently configured (for verification against docs). Checklist contents: - Confirm overload vs internal failure (error mix: overload-coded 429/503 vs 5xx); - Check breaker flapping (transition rate + cooldown); - Verify retry storm indicators (client-side, upstream); - Mitigation options: enable edge shedding flag, tighten queue bounds, shift traffic to alternate region/model, temporarily adjust breaker thresholds via admin toggle (if authorized), and rollback steps. Rollout: - Guarded behind INCIDENT_BOT_OVERLOAD_SNAPSHOT=1; enabled initially for SRE-managed workspaces only; - Includes unit tests for snapshot formatting and a contract test for routing admin response parsing. Notes: This does not page or create incidents automatically; it only annotates once an incident exists or when explicitly invoked. Follow-ups: Add deep links to per-route panels and attach trace exemplars once trace sampling is finalized (ENG-XXXX).
